label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: The Marketplace chatbot work and the cross-application logout fix (MT-1745) are closed; the homepage H1 fix (MT-1749) is Ready for Prod past its 26 Oct date, and the P1 broken chatbot product links bug (MT-1750) has no due date. In the Magento 2.4.9 upgrade (MT-1615, due 31 Oct) five more Amasty quote and RMA GraphQL subtasks moved to Dev or In Progress on 28 Oct (MT-1671 to MT-1674, MT-1687). Nagamuni Valluri took over the GraphQL 403 fix (MT-1754, back in Dev) and the invalid order-dates fix (MT-1757, in Code Review), Naman Bapna started the loyalty points fix (MT-1758), and a new bug, the wishlist cannot be opened (MT-1760), was raised for Nagamuni Valluri with no due date. Naveen Jangid's V1.4 Figma review (MT-1759) is due 28 Oct. GDPR and SOC-2 (MT-1616) is due 30 Nov. 14 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Figma validation of the v1.2 pages continued on 28 Oct with the Homepage (MR-1438, seven subtasks) and the People page (MR-1446, seven subtasks), all assigned to Kunal Jangid and due 30 Oct. The Microsoft Bookings integration (MR-1362), the homepage and People page updates (MR-1381, MR-1399) and the mobile category dropdown (MR-1382) moved to Code Review, the footer update (MR-1410) started, and Kannan Elangovan is testing three Partners and SLA page fixes (MR-1429, MR-1433, MR-1436). Vishnu kumar yadav deployed the Marketing CMS PHP 8.2.35 patch (MR-1422) on 27 Oct; the klaviyo-api Sonar fix (MR-1368) passed its 27 Oct date in Dev. A second v1.2 revamp story with no due date (MR-1411) still duplicates MR-1379. 16 items are past due, up from 15.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: On 28 Oct 111 USP items were deployed to production: 99 from UAT/Staging, the 11 that were Ready for Production and the group chats story (USP-4301). They include the S1 subscription calculation error (USP-4204), the S2 backend error cluster (USP-4199), the IAM and role security story (USP-4234), invoice issuing from the CRM (USP-4284) and the AI Factory storage configurator (USP-4403); the AI Factory page task (USP-4417) closed. Deployed In Prod is not a Done status in Jira, so these items still count as open and past-due items stay at 128. The S1 Document API 502 (USP-4231, due 30 Oct) is still TODO, the Highest security bug with no due date (USP-4369) is still TODO, and the pricing-rule eval security bug (USP-4414, due 2 Nov) has not started. The S2 usage-data bug for monthly and quarterly subscriptions (USP-4224) was closed as Won't Do, two stories moved to Backlog (USP-4307, USP-4352), and Livian Stefan Stan raised two Book a meeting fixes (USP-4429, USP-4430, due 31 Oct).

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Nareddy Shiva Prasad Reddy moved all six chatbot production bugs raised on 26 Oct to Ready for Prod on 28 Oct, including the P1 agent-request loop (UC-398), the exhausted-credits 429 error (UC-399), discovery-call booking and time zones (UC-394, UC-395) and two broken product links (UC-396, UC-400), together with the user-name handoff bug (UC-393); all are due 30 Oct. The same person started multi-turn context and thumbs up/down feedback (UC-60, UC-105, due 30 Oct). Ankit Saxena's knowledge-base and demand-tracking items (UC-27, UC-53, UC-54, UC-96, UC-97) are still in Dev past their 26 Oct date, and Shivam Dhoundiyal's CSM dashboard redesign (UC-238) is in Code Review. 54 items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Naveen Jangid closed CI build reproducibility (PULSE-9, PULSE-278 to PULSE-281) on 26 Oct and service health and dependency readiness (PULSE-11) with the CI verification and release gates subtasks (PULSE-73 to PULSE-80) on 27 Oct. On-prem production deployment (PULSE-10) is in progress with no date. No PULSE item is past due. Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: On 28 Oct Saurabh Jain closed the task to rehearse the 22 October demo and publish its evidence and runbook (ATLAS-288), together with the Gmail integration and lead-sync validation (ATLAS-285), and Gourav Agnani closed the demo journey and synthetic lead data (ATLAS-284). End-to-end regression and lead-flow fixing (ATLAS-287), the Gmail lead flow (ATLAS-282) and agent orchestration (ATLAS-286) are still in progress. Nagamuni Valluri has the Carbon set-up, UI wrappers, UI shell and i18n set-up in review (ATLAS-36 to ATLAS-38, ATLAS-40) and is fixing agent email reply loops (ATLAS-296). 267 of the 295 ATLAS tickets are unassigned and 293 have no due date.

programmes.name: Web-Identity

Ankit Sharma is on the Node.js upgrade (ID-772, due 31 Oct). Two epics have no owner (ID-770, ID-771). 6 items are past due.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: On 28 Oct Sarath Chandra closed the Devops copy of the production chatbot Azure Communication Services and Entra permissions task (IN-1178), which had sat in BLOCKER since its 21 Oct date. b.kumar verified the GitHub account (IN-1194), resolved the Marketing CMS backend slowdown and the Marketplace 504 errors (IN-1195) and started deploying the HRMS application to AKS (IN-1196, due 30 Oct). The Pulse pipeline set-up (IN-1165, IN-1166) and OpenTelemetry metrics monitoring (IN-1169, IN-1170) started, and the AKS agent migration (IN-1157, IN-1158) and Snyk scanning (IN-1161) were dated 30 Oct. k.kishore raised Front Door edge caching for portal assets (IN-1193, due 4 Nov) and is onboarding the Genesis console to Front Door (IN-1187, due 29 Oct). The Magento PHP upgrade (IN-1184), the UAT cron image fix (IN-1186), Magento 2.4.9 infrastructure readiness (IN-1181) and smart VM deallocation (IN-1189) are still past their 26 Oct date. 15 items sit in BLOCKER status and 27 are past due, down from 30.

On 28 Oct Murali G moved the authorship change (DM-1099) to review with a new 30 Oct date, and Shashi Prasad K reported that the /events/undefined soft 404 has come back (DM-1103, not started). 26 items are past due.
